newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ATHLETICS, DOPING - ROMANIAN RUNNER IULIA NEGURA TESTS POSITIVE.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS, DOPING - ROMANIAN RUNNER IULIA NEGURA TESTS POSITIVE.

text.p: European women's cross country champion Iulia Negura has failed an International Amateur Athletic Federation (IAAF) drugs test, the Romanian Athletics Federation (FRA) announced on Monday.
"The doping substance was stanozolol, a derivative of testosterone," a FRA statement said.
"According the IAAF rules, the FRA has set up a special investigation commission to look into Negura's case," FRA deputy general secretary Traian Badea told Reuters.
Negura, 30, took gold at the 1996 European cross-country championships in Charleroi, Belgium last month and silver with Romania in the team contest.
